rationale: REGN gapped up ~6% on strong earnings beat and is trading at 77% of today's wide range (~$96 wide), with price currently consolidating just below the 9-EMA ($914.44) in a tight 1-minute range showing no clear directional momentum. The broader market is under significant pressure (SPY -1.61%, VIXY +9.51%), which creates a headwind for further upside despite the positive catalyst, while the stock has already absorbed most of the gap move; the risk/reward for either direction is unclear given the choppy, low-volume consolidation and the conflict between stock-specific strength and macro weakness.
